hooks.command: file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file" in *.py) for d in backend bot; do case "$file" in *"/$d/"*) s="${file%%/$d/*}/$d"; (cd "$s" && uv run ruff format "$file" && uv run ruff check --fix "$file") 2>/dev/null; break;; esac; done;; esac || true

file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file" in *.ts|*.html|*.scss|*.css) case "$file" in */frontend/*) s="${file%%/frontend/*}/frontend"; (cd "$s" && npx prettier --write "$file" --log-level silent) 2>/dev/null;; esac;; esac || true

file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file" in *orm.py) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"orm.py modifie - pense a creer une migration Alembic si des colonnes ou tables ont change (/db-migrate)"}}';;  esac || true

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git push[[:space:]].*[[:space:]]main'; then echo '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"Push direct sur main bloque. Developpe sur la branche v2."}'; fi || true
